memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Psoriasis
  - Status: Plaques on elbows, knees, scalp; PASI 6.
  - Plan: Continue clobetasol 0.05% cream BD topically; add calcipotriol ointment OD; methotrexate 7.5 mg PO weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD; monitor LFT, CBC, creatinine.
- Rheumatoid arthritis
  - Status: Symmetrical joint pain in MCP and PIP joints, morning stiffness 45 min; ESR 28, CRP 12.
  - Plan: Methotrexate 10 mg PO weekly; folic acid 5 mg OD; hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD; prednisolone 5 mg OD; monitor ESR, CRP, RF, anti-CCP, LFT.
- Weight 68 kg, waist 82 cm (female cutoff 80 cm, slightly increased).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – whole grain toast with avocado; Lunch – mixed vegetable dal with brown rice; Dinner – grilled fish with steamed vegetables.
- Due: HbA1c on 2025-07-05.

memories.text: Referral to Dr S. Rao, Rheumatology, Vikram Hospital, for persistent joint symptoms despite DMARD therapy. Please assess need for biologic therapy. Enclose recent labs and disease activity scores.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Rheumatology review: Patient shows moderate disease activity (DAS28 3.8). Recommend adding a TNF‑alpha inhibitor (adalimumab 40 mg SC every other week) while continuing methotrexate and hydroxychloroquine. Continue folic acid. Return for review in 8 weeks.
